question: A theatre keeps all of its spare lightbulbs in one cupboard, and the electrician logs how long they burn in hours rather than in minutes. The cupboard held 126 bulbs in September, and 13 of them were found to be broken and were binned. The theatre group then bought enough bulbs to fill 7 cupboards of that size and stored them all in the one cupboard. Over the autumn season 283 bulbs were fitted into the stage rig. Over the winter season another 295 bulbs were used. How many bulbs are in the cupboard now?

The town swimming club keeps all of its members in one register. There were 174 members in January, and 53 people joined in February along with 10 more in early March. In April 110 members let their membership lapse. A dozen lifeguards work at the pool. Over the summer 8 people joined in June, 45 joined in July and 57 joined in August. The main pool is 25 metres long. How many members does the club have now?

Early on Monday morning a harbour crew found 68 crab pots stacked on the quay. 40 of them had rotten netting and were taken away to be mended. Before lunch each of the remaining pots was fitted with 3 bait bags. In the afternoon every one of those bags was filled with 6 sardines. That evening a fisherman tipped in 29 spare sardines that were left in his bucket. How many sardines did the crew use in total?

In the morning a stadium caterer laid out 8 trolleys, each carrying 83 boxed lunches. By midday that same number of boxed lunches had been prepared for each of the 9 gates around the ground. In the afternoon the organisers doubled the whole order because a second match was added to the day. That evening a driver found 17 more boxed lunches in his van and added them to the total. How many boxed lunches were prepared altogether?

The cupboard in the office at Fern Road School is the only place the pens are kept. At the start of term the cupboard held 38 pens, and the secretary added 66 pens from an old order. The head teacher then bought enough pens for the cupboard to hold 8 times as many as it did. A teacher returned 27 pens found in a classroom drawer. A parent later donated another 40 pens to the same cupboard. How many pens are in the cupboard now?

A taxi firm records all of its driving time in minutes rather than in hours. On Monday morning each of its 6 drivers logged 176 minutes on the road. In the afternoon the firm doubled that total by sending out a second, identical shift. By the evening half of all the logged minutes had been thrown out because a meter fault made them worthless. The firm then repeated exactly the same day for 6 days running, and one driver added 10 minutes of overtime to the week's total. That same six-day week was repeated in each of the 5 weeks of the month. How many minutes does the firm's monthly record show?

A launderette records its wash cycles in hours rather than in minutes. On Monday morning 4 machines were each loaded with 164 towels. Before lunch a hotel sent over 16 more towels for the same job. During the afternoon 335 towels were collected by their owners. In the evening head office asked all 6 of its branches to hold the same number of towels as this branch had left. How many towels do the 6 branches hold in total?

The bread rack at Otto's bakery is the only place he keeps his loaves. Early on Friday morning the rack held 171 loaves, and the second oven added 34 more before opening time. A coach party's order was so large that Otto doubled the number of loaves on the rack by baking an identical batch. At midday an apprentice put 65 freshly baked loaves onto the rack. In the evening a delivery from the sister bakery added 75 loaves to the same rack. How many loaves are on the rack now?

On Monday morning an orchard put 202 pears into the cold store, and by mid-morning 54 more had been picked and added. Before lunch the manager decided the store should hold 4 times as many pears, and enough were picked to make that happen. The orchard has 18 rows of trees. In the afternoon a neighbour brought 57 pears from her own garden, and 90 bruised pears were taken out and composted. In the evening head office asked each of its 9 orchards to fill a cold store with the same number of pears as this one. How many pears will the 9 orchards store altogether?

A parcel depot took in 8 cages, each containing 105 parcels. The parcels were divided equally between 3 delivery rounds, and one driver loaded a single round's share into his van. The depot van park has 14 spaces. A late collection added 65 parcels to that driver's load. A load of that same size is now planned for each of the 8 drivers who work on Saturdays. How many parcels will the Saturday drivers carry in total?

A kite shop keeps its whole stock of kites on one wall. On Saturday morning the wall held 64 kites, and 62 of them were sold in the first hour of a very windy day. Before lunch the owner unpacked new stock so that the wall held 6 times as many kites as were left on it. In the afternoon a supplier's van brought 17 more kites for the same wall. That evening 21 kites were sold to a school. How many kites are on the wall now?

Hana sews faster than her colleague Petro does, and their workshop records its sewing time in hours rather than in minutes. On Monday morning 7 rolls of fabric arrived, and each roll was cut into 108 squares. Before lunch the squares were shared equally between the 4 sewing tables, and Petro took one table's pile. In the afternoon the manager ordered 9 tables' worth of that same size for a hotel contract. That evening 1343 of those squares had already been sewn into quilts. How many squares are still waiting to be sewn?

On Monday morning Dalia counted 229 pairs of shoes in her stockroom, which is bigger than the one her colleague Emre looks after. 6 pairs were water-damaged and were thrown out before the shop opened. In the afternoon a delivery van brought 27 more pairs into the stockroom. That evening head office asked for 8 branches to each hold as many pairs as Dalia's stockroom. The company then tripled that whole order to get ready for the sales. How many pairs of shoes does the company's order come to?

Ravi weaves more cloth in a week than his cousin Sunita does. He started with 125 metres of thread and bought 27 metres more. The mill ordered 8 batches of exactly that length for the season. A supplier added 15 metres as a free sample. The mill then repeated the whole order for each of its 6 workshops. During the season 961 metres of thread were used up. How many metres of thread remain?

A garden centre received 226 bags of bulbs and then doubled the order because spring came early. Each of those bags holds 4 bulbs. The centre's car park has 60 spaces. Over the planting weekend 809 bulbs were sold. A landscaper returned 55 bulbs he had not been able to plant. How many bulbs does the garden centre have now?

A charity shop counts its stock in single books rather than in boxes. A house clearance brought in 9 sacks, each holding 143 books. In the first month 282 books were sold. A neighbour donated 27 books and a school gave another 49. Damp damage meant 131 books had to be thrown out, and the dozen volunteers who work there sorted the rest. A library then transferred 70 books to the shop. How many books does the shop have now?

A pottery class started the term with 16 blocks of clay, but half of them had dried out and were thrown away. Each usable block was cut in two, doubling the number of pieces on the table. Every piece was then shaped into 6 mugs. The class ran on 3 evenings that week, and the same number of mugs was made on each of those evenings. The teacher added 21 mugs left over from last term to the same shelf. How many mugs are on the shelf?

A gym records its sessions in hours rather than in minutes, and it keeps all of its locker keys on one board. The board held 93 keys in January, and 71 keys were issued to members for the year. Half of the keys still on the board were sent away to be re-cut and were never hung back up. In February 66 returned keys were added to the board, and in March a new order put 35 more on it. The chain now wants 7 gyms, each with a key board holding as many keys as this one. How many keys will the 7 gyms need?

Early on the morning of the harvest, each of the 9 pickers in a vineyard filled a basket with 36 bunches of grapes. By late morning every picker had filled 6 baskets of that size. In the afternoon the vineyard sent 6 teams of that same size out into the rows. The harvest ran to that plan on each of the 7 days of the week, finishing every evening at dusk. How many bunches of grapes were picked during the week?

Sana delivers more newspapers on her round than Callum does on his. The bundle at the shop door held 91 newspapers, and the driver added 28 more to it. A late edition put another 48 papers into the same bundle. The distributor then made up 9 bundles of that size for the whole town. By the end of the morning 833 of those newspapers had been delivered. How many newspapers are still to be delivered?

A quilting group keeps every finished square in one basket. On Monday morning the basket held 14 squares, and 35 more were finished before lunch. On Tuesday the group added 66 squares and on Wednesday another 80. The hall they meet in has 6 tables. On Thursday 60 squares were added to the basket, and on Friday 117 squares were sewn into a blanket and taken out of it. On Saturday evening a member brought in 40 squares she had made at home. How many squares are in the basket now?

A hotel keeps all of its spare bars of soap in one cupboard. The cupboard held 197 bars until 12 of them were found cracked and thrown away. Housekeeping added 35 bars from a room that was being refurbished. Before the summer season the manager tripled the number of bars in the cupboard. The hotel has 48 rooms. A supplier then sent 12 sample bars, which went into the same cupboard. How many bars of soap are in the cupboard now?

An aquarium shop measures its tanks in litres rather than in millilitres, and it keeps all of its guppies in one display tank. On Monday morning the tank held 142 guppies, and 5 were sold before lunch. In the afternoon a breeder brought 18 more guppies for the same tank. On Tuesday the shop moved in enough fish for the tank to hold 6 times as many guppies as it did. On Wednesday evening 62 young guppies hatched in the tank. How many guppies are in the display tank now?

Nour keeps more jam jars in her pantry than her neighbour Felix does. She had 135 empty jars at the start of the season, and 98 of them were filled with strawberry jam and given away. A further 29 empty jars were sold at the church fair. Felix then gave her 76 empty jars he no longer wanted. A glassworks doubled her collection of empty jars as a prize for winning the jam competition. Over the winter 139 jars were filled and sent to family, and in the spring 74 empty jars came back to her. How many empty jars does Nour have now?

A chess club records its games in whole hours rather than in minutes, and keeps all of its spare pieces in one box. On Monday morning the box held 18 pawns, but 3 were lost under the radiator and 2 more were chipped and thrown out. On Tuesday a member donated 66 pawns from old sets, and on Wednesday a school gave 51 more. The club meets in room 7 of the library. On Thursday a car-boot sale added 31 pawns to the box, and on Friday evening 92 pawns were given away to a beginners' class. How many pawns are in the box now?
